Which statement about silicon(IV) oxide, SiO2, is correct?
6
A
Itconducts electricity because it contains delocalised electrons.
B
It has a giant covalent structure with each silicon atom bonded to four oxygen atoms.
C
It is a simple covalent molecule.
D
Its structure is similar to that of graphite.
